attested.notes: Full humanise pass per the stage pack, Part A/B/C. Owner flagged the opening as AI-shaped ('For most directors who land here, the abstract definition is not what matters'), which was meta-reference to the reader as page-visitor. Two stranger reads run. First said the reader would leave during four sentences of definition before anyone spoke to them like a person; fixed by trimming the definition to its extractable core and moving the recognition line up. Second flagged 'conduct question', 'Official Receiver' and the scope note; all three rewritten in plain words. Also removed three aphorism-label repeats, the 'Most directors reading this page' callout title, and the remaining outcome-rate claims in the FAQs and callouts that were the same class the owner had already had removed from the body. Scenes now carry the page: the letter on the table, the October call a fortnight after the accountant flagged the VAT return, the March call with a petition served, the loan from the father-in-law, the auctioneer, the bank ringing the home phone, telling the staff. Warmth at the top ('braced for a telling-off') and at the decision point ('you do not need the accounts tidied up before you make that call'), deliberately different lines to avoid a repeat device.
